follow_up_changes.change: Quic.IO.GenUDP.open/1 starts its actor with GenServer.start/2 and links only after init has a socket, so a failed bind is an ordinary {:error, reason} instead of an exit signal that killed the owner (de1b8d3).
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: the only calls introduced are GenServer.start/2 and Process.link/1 with literal module/function; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.

follow_up_changes.change: ConnectionOwner.terminate/2 now runs QuicHttp3.Session.close/1 under guarded/4 on an orderly :normal stop of a ready or draining owner, then retires the cleanup lease; the :http3_retire handler no longer retires before stopping, so the close is admitted first (RFC 9114 section 5.2, H3_NO_ERROR).
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: the new calls are the literal Session.close/1 inside the existing guarded/4 closure invocation, and the file holds no reviewed occurrence. Session.close/1 reaches only the already reviewed retained session.transport close and cleanup operations (H3-1).

follow_up_changes.change: HTTP.HTTP3.Pool no longer retires an exclusive owner's cleanup lease on release; it sends :http3_retire so the owner closes with H3_NO_ERROR before retiring, and still retires on owner DOWN.
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: one literal Quic.Cleanup.retire/2 call path is removed; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.

follow_up_changes.change: capabilities/0 reports resumption: true and migration.local: [:client] after the CI-confirmed M2/R1/R2 matrices (b1276f9); literal map change only.
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.

follow_up_changes.change: capabilities/0 reports resumption: true and zero_rtt: true (b2239e7); literal map change only.
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.

follow_up_changes.change: ConnectionOwner marks itself :retiring when the watchdog, attempt tracker or creator goes DOWN, so terminate/2 skips the graceful close of the already retired connection; graceful_close/2 now also requires that no request remains, so a stop that abandons live requests through fail_all/2 keeps the previous retire/abort path instead of claiming H3_NO_ERROR.
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: the change is a lifecycle field update and a map_size/1 guard; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.

follow_up_changes.change: Quic.IO.GenUDP.open/1 passes the caller to init, and the actor links to that still-blocked caller at the end of a successful init instead of the caller linking after GenServer.start/2 returns, so an actor that already stopped can no longer kill the non-trapping caller with :noproc.
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: the literal Process.link/1 call moves from open/1 into initialize_socket/3 with a Keyword.fetch!/2 argument; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.

follow_up_changes.change: An extended CONNECT request whose response stream finished is marked done? and no longer counts as live, so graceful_close/2 still sends H3_NO_ERROR after a WebTransport session closed by a compliant peer; any other remaining request keeps suppressing it.
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: the change adds a request map field, a put_in/2 update and an Enum.any?/2 over the request map; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.

follow_up_changes.change: ConnectionOwner computes the default opening deadline lazily from HTTP.HTTP3.opening_timeout/1, so connect_timeout: :infinity keeps the finite 5,000 ms QUIC opening budget.
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: Keyword.get_lazy/3 receives a local closure whose body is literal now/0 and HTTP.HTTP3.opening_timeout/1 calls; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.

follow_up_changes.change: The H3 session sends RFC 9114 connection error codes on detected connection errors, resets WebTransport streams on session end, rejects malformed datagrams and field values, and routes close(code, phrase) through the retained transport.
